records.jp: ――ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: ...Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Hina.
records.en: —Hina-chan.

records.jp: ……声だ
records.en_original: A voice?
records.en_auxiliary: A voice?
records.en: ...A voice.

records.jp: 誰かの声が聞こえる……
records.en_original: I hear a voice...
records.en_auxiliary: I hear a voice...
records.en: I hear a voice...

records.jp: ヒナちゃん
records.en_original: Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Hina.
records.en: Hina-chan.

records.jp: 私、呼ばれてる……
records.en_original: They're calling me.
records.en_auxiliary: They're calling me.
records.en: It is calling me...

records.jp: これって、誰の声……？
records.en_original: Who do the voices belong to?
records.en_auxiliary: Who do the voices belong to?
records.en: Whose voice is this...?

records.jp: 今まで出てきた人とは違う声、だよね
records.en_original: No one we know, right?
records.en_auxiliary: No one we know, right?
records.en: They are different from the voices we have heard so far, right?

records.jp: この声……？
records.en_original: That voice...
records.en_auxiliary: That voice...
records.en: That voice...

records.jp: この声は――
records.en_original: The voices belong to—
records.en_auxiliary: The voices belong to—
records.en: The voices belong to—

records.jp: ユズたちはずっと待ってたの。ヒナちゃんのことを
records.en_original: We've been waiting a long time for you, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: We've been waiting a long time for you, Hina.
records.en: We've been waiting for you, Hina-chan.

records.jp: 一緒に世界を守るために
records.en_original: To protect the world together.
records.en_auxiliary: To protect the world together.
records.en: So we can protect the world together.

records.jp: ユズと、ライム……
records.en_original: Yuzu and Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and Lime...
records.en: Yuzu and Lime...

records.jp: 今のが最初に言ってた子たちなんだ……！
records.en_original: The girls you were talking about earlier!
records.en_auxiliary: The girls you were talking about earlier!
records.en: Those are the girls you mentioned at first...!

records.jp: うん。私の、とっても大切な友達
records.en_original: Yes. Two very important friends of mine.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. Two very important friends of mine.
records.en: Yes. Two very important friends of mine.

records.jp: 私ね……バレエができなくなってから、<CR>ずっとふさぎ込んでたんだ
records.en_original: I...had a hard time after I had to quit ballet.
records.en_auxiliary: I...had a hard time after I had to quit ballet.
records.en: After I became unable to do ballet,<CR>I shut myself away for a long time.

records.jp: 学校へも行かずに、ずっと部屋の中にいてさ。<CR>通うことになる学校の入学式にすら、参加しなかった
records.en_original: I was constantly locked up in my room. I missed my whole first semester.
records.en_auxiliary: I was constantly locked up in my room. I missed my whole first semester.
records.en: I stopped going to school and stayed shut in my room.<CR>I didn't even go to my new school's entrance ceremony.

records.jp: それから夏になって、勇気を出して登校して……
records.en_original: Then summer came, and finally I forced myself to go to school...
records.en_auxiliary: Then summer came, and finally I forced myself to go to school...
records.en: Then summer came, and I worked up the courage to go to school...

records.jp: 普通の学生生活も、これからどう生きればいいかも<CR>わからない。そんな時に――
records.en_original: But I had no idea how to live a normal school life... I didn't know why I should live at all. But then—
records.en_auxiliary: But I had no idea how to live a normal school life... I didn't know why I should live at all. But then—
records.en: I didn't know how to live a normal school life<CR>or what I was supposed to do with my life. Then—

records.jp: 出会ったのが、ユズとライムだった
records.en_original: I met Yuzu and Lime.
records.en_auxiliary: I met Yuzu and Lime.
records.en: I met Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: 大切な友達、か……
records.en_original: Important friends... Sounds like it.
records.en_auxiliary: Important friends... Sounds like it.
records.en: Important friends... Sounds like it.

records.jp: それにしても「世界を守る」って……。<CR>一体どういうこと？
records.en_original: But still, "protect the world"? What does that mean?
records.en_auxiliary: But still, "protect the world"? What does that mean?
records.en: But "protect the world"...<CR>What does that mean?

records.jp: 二人はね。<CR>私をリフレクターにしてくれたんだ
records.en_original: Yuzu and Lime... They made me a Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and Lime... They made me a Reflector.
records.en: Those two<CR>made me a Reflector.

records.jp: ……ええ！？　り、リフレクター！？
records.en_original: What?! A Reflector?
records.en_auxiliary: What?! A Reflector?
records.en: What?! A Reflector?

records.jp: 指輪をくれた、ってこと？
records.en_original: Then they gave you that ring?
records.en_auxiliary: Then they gave you that ring?
records.en: Then they gave you that ring?

records.jp: うん。私はリフレクターになって……<CR>ユズとライム、二人と協力して戦った
records.en_original: Yeah. I became a Reflector and fought alongside them.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah. I became a Reflector and fought alongside them.
records.en: Yes. I became a Reflector...<CR>and fought together with Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: “ユズとライム”って、何者……？
records.en_original: Just who exactly are Yuzu and Lime...?
records.en_auxiliary: Just who exactly are Yuzu and Lime...?
records.en: Just who exactly are Yuzu and Lime...?

records.jp: ……ごめん。まだ、そこまでは……
records.en_original: ...Sorry. I still don't remember much.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Sorry. I still don't remember much.
records.en: ...Sorry. I still don't remember much.

records.jp: そっか……
records.en_original: Huh...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...
records.en: Huh...

records.jp: でも、リフレクターについて何か知ってるなら<CR>二人のことは詳しく知ったほうがいいよね
records.en_original: If they know something about Reflectors, we should try to learn more about them.
records.en_auxiliary: If they know something about Reflectors, we should try to learn more about them.
records.en: But if they know something about Reflectors,<CR>we should learn more about those two.

records.jp: うん。私たち全員に関わる部分でもある……
records.en_original: Yes. It is something that affects us all.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. It is something that affects us all.
records.en: Yes. It is something that affects us all.

records.jp: にしてもすごい人生だね、日菜子さん。<CR>奇想天外というか、なんというか……
records.en_original: You've lived quite the life, Hinako. It's like something out of a fantasy novel...
records.en_auxiliary: You've lived quite the life, Hinako. It's like something out of a fantasy novel...
records.en: What an incredible life, Hinako-san.<CR>So extraordinary, or...

records.jp: あはは。良くも悪くも、退屈はしなかったかな
records.en_original: Ahaha. I don't know if that's a good or bad thing, but it definitely wasn't boring.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha. I don't know if that's a good or bad thing, but it definitely wasn't boring.
records.en: Ahaha. I don't know if that's a good or bad thing, but it definitely wasn't boring.

records.jp: （退屈しなかった、か……）
records.en_original: (Never boring, huh...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Never boring, huh...)
records.en: (Never boring, huh...)

records.jp: （いいな。<CR>才能にもチャンスにも恵まれていて）
records.en_original: (How nice...to have both talent and luck on your side.)
records.en_auxiliary: (How nice...to have both talent and luck on your side.)
records.en: (How nice.<CR>She was blessed with both talent and opportunities.)

records.jp: あ、見て……！
records.en_original: Oh, look!
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, look!
records.en: Oh, look!

records.jp: あの先に、続きがあるんですね
records.en_original: That door looks like it may lead somewhere.
records.en_auxiliary: That door looks like it may lead somewhere.
records.en: That door looks like it may lead somewhere.

records.jp: ユズ、ライム……
records.en_original: Yuzu, Lime...
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu, Lime...
records.en: Yuzu, Lime...

records.jp: 待ってて。今行くから
records.en_original: Wait for me. I'm coming.
records.en_auxiliary: Wait for me. I'm coming.
records.en: Wait for me. I'm coming.
